turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So what brings you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've had, I've had a cough for a number of years now, but store these past like day, it's gotten a lot quite a bit worse and I've been really short of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so how many days would you say you've been short of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Less than a day, maybe just really kind of started last night and has carried out throughout this morning. I, I called this morning to get an appointment.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and it, was it brought on by any activities or were you doing anything at that time before it started?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, last last night I was, well, I was just doing my regular kind of routine after dinner - cleaning up and just the cough started first. And over, the over the night it got worse. I could just couldn't catch my breath and that was similar this morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you've also had a cough.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I have. Yeah, uh, I've had a cough for a long time now, but it's been worse over this last day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, is it like a wet cough or dry cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's wet, I I'm bring up sputum most of the time, but it's been, it's usually like white or clear and it's a lot more like, uh it's a lot more greenish, yellow and, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are you having any kind of fevers or chills anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm yeah I, I did have some chills last night, so I'm not sure about a fever though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And are your symptoms at all, so you do have a shortness of breath, but any kind of chest pain at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do have some chest pressure for sure. I just feels like I can't, can't ah, catch my breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so is it mostly related to your breathing or do you have it at rest? Or do you have it with any exertion?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I think it, it's there kind of most of the time, like the chest pressure. I kind of feel it throughout my chest when when I'm breathing but, but also just kind of sitting here I can kind of feel it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK I see. And are all of your symptoms constant? Or do they come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: They've been constant and they've got been getting worse since since last night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had this happen to you before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It has, yeah, I, actually last last winter I was hospitalized for a COPD exacerbation for, for a few days. I I know I got some antibiotics and umm, I needed some oxygen.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see and did you go home on home oxygen at all? Like do you use oxygen at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I was told I didn't need any any yet, but if I didn't quit smoking I might in the future.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are you using any kind of puffers at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I I do I I use I think it's called like Spiriva or something like that. I use that every day and there's another one that I'll use like if my symptoms are getting bad. My blue one. I did try that actually last night and it didn't, it helped a little bit, but, not not enough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so have you just tried like tried it one time last night? Have you tried it after that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, we just tried it last night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so nothing today right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Other than that, so you did have an admission before for this. And you have COPD. Do you have any other symptoms right now? Like runny nose, sore throat, any cold like symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I I I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Did you have it before these symptoms started?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm no, I've been feeling, I've been feeling OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you traveled at all recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, well, I did, I just go up to the trailer not too long ago to visit some family, but that's just an hour away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Anyone sick around you recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And is there, are you having any headache or nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And besides the time you got hospitalized, have you had any exacerbations after that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I just had that, had that happen, the one time, last year.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you feel that your symptoms are similar, worse, or how do they compare to last time, if you remember?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Pretty similar. I think last time I was worse, but I waited longer last time and so that's why I was concerned and and wanted to come in early.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, uh, alright, so uh, have you had any fevers at all or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've I've had some chills last night like I just couldn't get warm. I was loading up on blankets and it didn't seem to help.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK so we'll get a temperature on you today as well. Do you feel that you're breathing faster at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not necessarily it, just it just harder to to, feel like I can't catch my breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you feel fatigued at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah yeah, I I have a, I mean I have been feeling just tired this morning, but I think that's more to do with the fact that I just can't really do a whole lot of exertion because as soon as I move around I'm, I can't breathe.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. Uhm OK, and are you having any kind of diarrhea, constipation, or any urinary troubles at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I'm not.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any changes in your sleep or appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That's been that's been normal. Been eating well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any kind of confusion or any do you feel like yourself?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I do.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any confusion at all that anyone's noticed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so. I feel like that's been ok.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I I have noticed some wheezing. It's usually I usually, uh well I've been told I have a wheeze, but I can actually hear it right now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, we'll do like a full physical examination as well. And we'll get like your oxygenation level and everything like that. Umm, do you have any, besides COPD, so when were you diagnosed with you please?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: About 10 years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have any other medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do, yeah. I have a high blood pressure, type two diabetes and like and there's something wrong with my, with my kidneys as well. I think my EGFR is low or something like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh, I see, OK. And do you take any medications besides your puffers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I I do. I I take on an ACE inhibitor, Metformin, SGLT2 inhibitor and I'm also taking a, uh, a water pill as well 'cause I, over these last couple of years I've had some more swelling in my in my feet.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. Do you have any swelling, increased swelling right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I that's been about this. Been pretty constant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you feel recently at all that you're short of breath when lying down, or do you have to wake up to take a deep breath? Anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't only brought issues like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any any kind of dizziness or fainting episodes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any increased sweating associated with your chest tight or pressure or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I haven't been sweaty.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Yeah. And other than that, any previous surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I, yeah I had a Uterine prolapse, so I had surgery for that. I have five kids.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any, any complications after that surgery at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it helped, it actually fixed the leaking at the time I was having, so was happy with that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: That's good. Currently right now, do you work at all or are you retired?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I am retired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and what is your living situation like right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, we live in a house just outside of the city with my, with my husband.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any exposures to any dust, fumes, asbestos or anything like that in your home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't believe so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm and do you currently smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I do, yeah. Currently, yeah, maybe half a pack to a pack per day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long have you smoked for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, I started in my teens, so most of my life I've I've smoked. I grew up around it, it's just what my parents did and everybody smoked.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and do you use any recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you drink alcohol at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, very rarely, don't really drink it anymore.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, so yeah, those are some of the questions I had for you today. We'll do a full physical examination, get your vitals and get your oxygenation done right now. Do you have any questions at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that that makes sense. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome and yeah so we'll, we'll also do some lab work as well. We'll get some blood work done. Want to make sure we don't miss any kind of infection. We might have to do a chest x-ray as well, but for now I would say just sit tight. We'll get all your vitals done and then go on from there. Does that sound good?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds good. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and if you feel at all you're very short of breath and we can give you some ventil in here as well. turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, that sounds good. Thank you.
